entries.abstract: Exact final-gradient bounds for convex functions with Lipschitz gradient on real Hilbert spaces, under an initial-distance bound, for every horizon and nonnegative constant step. The factor is the maximum of reciprocal linear progress and the quadratic oscillation power, with genuine smooth convex attaining examples. The formalization includes the joint progress potential, complete sampled equality trajectories in both strict branches and at balance, and a direct transfer from actual constrained proximal minimizers to sharp residual and terminal objective-residual bounds. All ten principal declarations are listed in comparator.json; VERIFICATION.md records checks.
entries.title: Sharp last-iterate bounds and extremal trajectories for constant-step gradient descent

entries.abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of Guy Robin's 1984 equivalence between the Riemann hypothesis and the strict divisor-sum inequality sigma(n) < exp(gamma) n log(log n) for every integer n > 5040.  The development also proves the restriction to colossally abundant integers, reconstructs the Nicolas--Landau oscillation argument used for the converse implication, and checks the finite ranges with exact Lean certificates.  It also formalizes Lagarias's 2001 elementary harmonic-number criterion and its equivalence to the Riemann hypothesis. This is a formalization of equivalence criteria; it does not prove the Riemann hypothesis.
entries.title: Robin1984
